description: The bar chart illustrates the macro f-score of two methods, GAIT_{GAT} and RECA, on the Semtab dataset across three frequency classes: High, Medium, and Low. The vertical axis represents the macro f-score, which ranges from 0 to 1, and the horizontal axis categorizes the frequency classes. For the High frequency class, GAIT_{GAT} has a macro f-score of 0.877, while RECA has a slightly lower score of 0.837. In the Medium frequency class, GAIT_{GAT} scores 0.609, and RECA scores 0.538. For the Low frequency class, GAIT_{GAT} has a macro f-score of 0.224, and RECA has a score of 0.114. The bars are color-coded, with GAIT_{GAT} represented in a darker shade and RECA in a lighter shade. The chart does not indicate any sorting or emphasis on specific bars.
